description: We are Team Nokhottro (নক্ষত্র, “star”): Fariya Hossain, Mehbuba Uddin and Ishadi Kabir Protha, three friends who teamed up online from different countries to make NASA’s history an adventure for young explorers. For the Abandoned but not Forgotten challenge, we created Space Junk: The Great Space Mess!, a 7-minute animated episode where Spark, a little spacecraft, meets the Moon, Mars and the real NASA hardware left behind, and learns why we must keep Earth’s orbit clean. ✨
